headline: South African Rand Tumbles Near 17.49 as Reserve Bank Flags Rate Hike Readiness
summary: The South African rand slid toward 17.49 per dollar, prompting the South African Reserve Bank to warn it will not hesitate to hike rates again if needed, with inflation seen above 5% into 2027.
why: Currency depreciation stokes imported inflation in South Africa, forcing the central bank to maintain higher borrowing costs that weigh on domestic growth.

impacts.name: South African Rand
impacts.why: The rand slid toward 17.49 per dollar amid elevated inflation forecasts.
